plan.title: Single-stage RFQ mapped and named vendors

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ and the named lot-award mode.
Provide the mandatory event title required for publishing.
Apply the available RFQ template before adding products.
Add the specified product and quantity 10, allowing the product variant to be populated.
Complete the remaining pricing-sheet fields before scheduling and publishing.
Set the requested delivery location on the first product row.
Confirm the product selection populated the expected variant.
Add every vendor mapped to the selected product using the product's own Invite Vendor control.
Add the explicitly named Vendor C; the product flow should avoid adding it twice if it was already mapped.
Commit the 30-minute schedule with the event starting now.
Confirm publishing reached a real project page.
Open the published RFQ stage's Participants list.
Verify that the explicitly named Vendor C is a selected participant.
Confirm the published stage has participants after adding mapped vendors and Vendor C.
